promotion.title: EU AI Act - Annex III point 4: employment, workers management and access to self-employment (high-risk)
promotion.summary: Annex III lists the use cases classified high-risk under Article 6(2). Point 4 covers employment: recruitment, selection, candidate evaluation, and work-related decisions.
concepts: EU AI Act - Annex III point 4

promoted_passages.quote: AI systems intended to be used for the recruitment or selection of natural persons, in particular to place targeted job advertisements, to analyse and filter job applications, and to evaluate candidates;
promoted_passages.why_it_matters: Annex III point 4 is what makes recruitment and candidate-evaluation systems high-risk.

promoted_passages.quote: 4. Employment, workers’ management and access to self-employment: (a) AI systems intended to be used for the recruitment or selection of natural persons, in particular to place targeted job advertisements, to analyse and filter job applications, and to evaluate candidates; (b) AI systems intended to be used to make decisions affecting terms of work-related relationships, the promotion or termination of work-related contractual relationships, to allocate tasks based on individual behaviour or personal traits or characteristics or to monitor and evaluate the performance and behaviour of persons in such relationships.
promoted_passages.why_it_matters: Annex III point 4 is what makes recruitment and candidate-evaluation systems high-risk.
